title: Messages
body: The list of conversations shows the last message (your own marked “You:”) and the number of unread ones; an empty list explains that people appear once they sign up. ^rbtf
A person writes to someone; the message shows up for both at once. ^send
A message shows when it was sent: “just now”, “5 min ago”, a date for older ones. ^yy76
Offline nothing can be sent: the message box says why. ^2ntc
